event_format.container: UTF-8 JSONL, one wrapper per event
event_format.other_fields: Preserve existing normalized row fields; no renaming or float epoch conversion. Range rows retain the existing PR45 schema.
event_format.missing_or_nonfinite: Explicit rejection/status; do not silently drop, zero-fill, interpolate or insert a future record. Keep original table identity.

required_new_entrypoint.configuration: baseline configuration plus a separately validated imu_prototype object; A freezes and supplies its exact schema and parameter protocol before B numerical replay

estimate_schema.covariance: Pose marginal covariance stays 3x3; augmented state/covariance is separately named in decisions. Invalid/undefined values use blank/null with reason, not a fabricated bound.
estimate_schema.legacy_mode: Bias/IMU provenance fields blank with explicit legacy_not_used status; do not pretend the frozen six-state posterior is eight-state calibrated.

field_configuration_rule: Synthetic-design values require explicit engineering assumption declaration before field use; no silent promotion to measured. Same-host mapping, mounting/sign and historical calibration remain conditional.
observability_rule: Report weak/unobservable bias under stationary/straight/weak UWB geometry; no forced convergence and no covariance-as-certified-accuracy claim.
